title: The Reader's Context Window — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of The Reader's Context Window's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. No challenger read it. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.title: Where the eye has to go
pieces.caption: The same three blocks stacked two ways. With context wedged between question and answers the eye loops back up; with context on top it reads down once. *What is real and what is a choice:* The eye paths are illustrative, not eye-tracking.

verdicts.file: The Reader's Context Window — rich — where the eye has to go.svg
verdicts.why: It draws exactly the sentence and the Origin story (the question floating above the context, the eye jumping over it to reach the buttons), and the right panel seats the question on its answers as the first rule asks. The honest line is true. Note: the red path is four overlapping curves with no arrowheads, so the sequence in its legend cannot be followed;
